status: source audit; no runtime edits or native acceptance
scope: ordinary enemy programs; static More Spikes targets

pc.zero: read length byte once, then advance to1; lengths98/102/115 decode b/f/s
pc.increment: before action; wrap to1 if incremented PC>unsigned length
pc.boundedValidation: nonempty length1..255; initialPC0..length; reject negative/outside PC
pc.zeroBasedAdapter: sourcePC>=1 => cursor=sourcePC-1; sourcePC0 requires an explicit one-shot length-byte state

target.staticMatch: exact Point equality; first configured present source index
target.limits: moving/state tolerance and cached-secondary-position branches require separate support

perClassSubstep: advance integer frame by current direction

timer.perClass: remainder += cappedInput*multiplier; while remainder>=activeDivisor subtract/increment; delta=newCount-oldCount
timer.backlog: snapshot full MT input count; capped excess discarded
timer.dispatch: one sprite callback on changed class count; callback loops class.delta times
timer.presentation: continuous SVG angle may interpolate but must not determine source decisions
